title: STRUCTUREDAGENT: Planning with AND/OR Trees for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2603.05294v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing LLM-based web agents struggle on complex, long-horizon tasks due to limited in-context memory, weak planning abilities, and greedy behaviors that lead to premature termination. To address these challenges, we propose \SA{}, a hierarchical planning framework that interleaves planning and execution via dynamic $\ANDOR$ trees. The framework separates structural planning from LLM-based reasoning, enabling principled error recovery through node repair, systematic exploration of alternatives via OR nodes, and modular plans that can facilitate human intervention. On WebArena (630 tasks), \SA{} achieves a $\sim$53\% success rate vs.\ $\sim$46\% for AgentOccam, and on complex multi-constraint Amazon shopping tasks, gains reach 10\% over the strongest baseline.

translated_title: STRUCTUREDAGENT：基于与/或树的长时程网页任务规划
translated_abstract: 现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的网页智能体由于上下文记忆有限、规划能力薄弱以及导致任务过早终止的贪心行为，在复杂的长时程任务上表现不佳。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了STRUCTUREDAGENT，一个通过动态与/或树（AND/OR trees）将规划与执行交替进行的分层规划框架。该框架将结构性规划与基于LLM的推理相分离，从而实现通过节点修复进行有原则的错误恢复、通过OR节点系统性地探索备选方案，并提供便于人工干预的模块化计划。在WebArena（630个任务）上，STRUCTUREDAGENT取得了约53%的成功率，而AgentOccam约为46%；在复杂的多约束亚马逊购物任务上，相比最强基线提升了10%。
tldr: 提出STRUCTUREDAGENT分层规划框架，通过动态与/或树将结构性规划与LLM推理分离，实现有原则的错误恢复、备选方案系统探索和模块化计划，在WebArena上成功率达约53%，并在复杂多约束购物任务上超越最强基线10%。
en_tdlr: STRUCTUREDAGENT is a hierarchical planning framework that interleaves planning and execution via dynamic AND/OR trees, separating structural planning from LLM-based reasoning to enable principled error recovery, systematic exploration of alternatives, and modular plans, achieving ~53% success on WebArena and up to 10% gains over the strongest baseline on complex multi-constraint tasks.
